params.name: b
params.resample_while: lcm(a, b) == a or lcm(a, b) == b

solution: The denominators are ${=a}$ and ${=b}$, so the common denominator is ${=d}$.
Multiply every term on both sides by ${=d}$: ${=d}\times\frac{x}{{=a}}+{=d}\times\frac{x}{{=b}}={=d}\times{=c}$
Check by substituting $x={=r}$: $\frac{{=r}}{{=a}}+\frac{{=r}}{{=b}}={=r//a}+{=r//b}={=c}$, which equals the right-hand side.
notes: Entry point of the skill, modelled on book ex4-1-32 (x over two denominators, constant on the right). Denominators are drawn from 2..6 and never one dividing the other, so both multipliers m and n are at least 2 (no '1x' is ever printed) and the common denominator is a genuine lcm. The answer is built as k times the lcm and the right-hand side computed from it, so every instance has a whole-number answer (6 to 60). Hand-checked: a=2, b=3, k=1 gives x/2 + x/3 = 5, x = 6; a=4, b=6, k=2 gives x/4 + x/6 = 10, x = 24.
